end_state.definition: Autonomous, accountable, affordable public-interest operation that repeatedly produces independently verified external outcomes across regions without depending on recruited external contributors or constant owner direction.

requirements: All reported outcomes have public primary-source before/after evidence and attribution caveats
At least two separate reviewers or methods on consequential claims; qualified domain review when required
One canonical task/lease owner; bounded and observable execution; demonstrable privacy and revocation
No dependency on volunteer registration to keep the core outcome pipeline active

end_state.note: This is the target state, not current observed performance or a guaranteed delivery date.

baseline.note: Four reported-before-correction, independently public-source verified WIN records; WIN-004's link to the IRS's edit is temporal only, not proven causal. Total historical wins, not four in the rolling 28-day window.

milestones.name: Fourth verified external correction
milestones.acceptance: A fourth independently verified external implementation documented in WIN-LEDGER.md with original public source, dated after-state, agency/maintainer attribution and limits.
milestones.evidence_scope: IRS 2025 EITC translated numeric corrections verified Nov7, readback Nov22, after Sep18 report; no proof of causal attribution or taxpayer outcomes.

milestones.name: Repeatable low-cost owner-operated case cycle
milestones.acceptance: Two distinct cases moved through primary-source verification, bounded permitted action and independently checked final dispositions, with zero new paid API calls; at least one full case advanced without the founder performing each step.
milestones.blocked_on: Need two distinct owner-independent, zero-new-cash case cycles with verified outside source dispositions; four total WIN records do not prove operational repeatability.
next_steps: Retain OT-003 and OT-013 as two active case cycles; only respond to new material correspondence or due Nov30/Dec2 source checks.
For every case log evidence snapshot, reviewed permitted action, live external disposition, human/independent source check, and cycle time.
Re-use existing hourly coordinator for scheduling; do not require new volunteers or Ollama on a memory-constrained laptop.

milestones.name: Portable Foundry executor with verified safeguards
milestones.acceptance: One genuine model-generated bounded public-safe artifact, independent evidence review, tested authorization/failure/budget ceilings, canonical leases and no duplicate scheduler; a laptop/volunteer must not be required to keep the ordinary case pipeline operating.

milestones.name: Cross-border replication
milestones.acceptance: Independently verified outcomes across at least two countries with local-source provenance and reviewed language/context, repeatable without new paid inference accounts.

milestones.name: Worldwide sustainable operation
milestones.acceptance: Meet end_state.acceptance over a rolling 28-day measurement window, including qualified review, privacy/deletion controls, credible operational uptime and zero unapproved cost.

operating_rules.primary_metric: verified case cycle completions with independent external disposition and measured owner effort/cost; WIN-004 already counts historically once, not a new November 22 IRS edit
operating_rules.secondary_metric: completed legitimate source checks and verified external actions, each distinct from outcomes
priority_order: Urgent safety/incident or substantive institutional reply with directly relevant evidence
Due OT-003 or OT-013 public-source recheck tied to active G2 cycle
Within WIP=2, resolve a documented bottleneck in repeatable zero-cost discovery→verification→permitted action→external disposition, with executable or outcome receipt
Only if no due case and a clearly superior official-source opportunity is proven: replace one focus case with explanation and maintain WIP=2
disallowed_as_progress: Only creating plans, tests, diagrams or roles
Unverified LLM messages, social reactions or unscreened volunteer responses
Unanswered email or report sent without verified public change
Stale repeat source checks absent a changed trigger
Automatic model usage without proven hard provider stop and budget
operating_rules.routine_external_contact: No repeat contact after the single dated follow-up for either focus case absent new material evidence or the recipient requesting it.
operating_rules.permission_boundary: Safe read-only checking, evidence capture, public project code fixes and bounded authorized factual replies may proceed without redundant owner re-confirmation. Higher-risk external publication, spending, account creation, new recurring workers, private-data processing and governance changes retain specific existing safeguards.
operating_rules.worker_source: Original enabled Humanity Loop hourly coordinator; do not create a second worker.
